$comment: Source file-size exceptions for scripts/check-file-size.mjs (audit 2026-10-07 P1-7). Production source is capped at 800 lines. Each file here names why it is longer and is capped at its size when listed: it may shrink, never grow, and a cap more than 25 lines above the file must be lowered. Delete an entry once the file is under 800 lines.

apps/desktop/src/main/db/schema.ts.reason: Declarative: one Drizzle table definition per entity. Splitting by table would scatter the relations drizzle-kit reads from one schema module.

apps/desktop/src/main/ipc/register.ts.reason: Declarative: one ipcMain.handle binding per channel, held in parity with the preload, REQUEST_CHANNELS and the shared-types IpcContract by channel-parity.test.ts. Split candidate by the same bounded contexts as ipc/handlers/.

apps/desktop/src/main/orchestrator/execu.reason: Pending decomposition: split the workspace path sandbox from the individual execution tools.

apps/desktop/src/main/orchestrator/index.reason: Pending decomposition: the dispatcher (pending queue, concurrency caps, scheduleDispatch) is the first seam to move out of the facade.

apps/desktop/src/main/orchestrator/run-a.reason: Pending decomposition: separate tool-call handling from the streaming turn loop.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/agentic-l.reason: Pending decomposition: separate run bookkeeping (threads, runs, audit) from provider adaptation.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/agentic-t.reason: Pending decomposition: one module per write-side tool (decompose_project, create_tickets, assign_work) with shared validation.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/autonomy-.reason: Pending decomposition: separate the benchmark scenarios from the runner and scoring.
Pending decomposition: one module per doctor check family behind the report builder.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/budget-go.reason: Pending decomposition: separate budget policy evaluation from persistence and notifications.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/command-s.reason: Pending decomposition: separate the parse pipeline (classifier, resolver, slot filler) from execute dispatch.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/company-p.reason: Pending decomposition: split export, import preview, import apply and template library into separate modules behind the service facade.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/context-a.reason: Pending decomposition: one module per context source (thread, tickets, memory, vault) behind the assembler.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/copilot-a.reason: Pending decomposition: separate scheduling (periodic and event-triggered ticks) from insight generation and dedup.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/external-.reason: Pending decomposition: one module per external runtime adapter.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/local-ggu.reason: Pending decomposition: separate the resumable download manager from Hub search and model cards.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/paperclip.reason: Pending decomposition: separate reading the external export folder from mapping it to a Team-X preview.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/provider-.reason: Pending decomposition: separate per-provider stream adapters from the employee-to-provider resolution.

apps/desktop/src/main/services/skills-se.reason: Pending decomposition: separate skill installation (fetch, verify) from the registry.

apps/desktop/src/preload/api.ts.reason: Declarative: the CHANNELS table and one window.teamx binding per channel, held in parity by channel-parity.test.ts. Split candidate by the same bounded contexts as shared-types ipc/bridge-*.ts.

apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/a.reason: Pending decomposition: each autonomy tab body becomes its own component.
Pending decomposition: split the profile editor form from the profile list and bindings.

apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/c.reason: Pending decomposition: split the parse/clarify/confirm state machine into a hook and the result panes into components.

apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/d.reason: Pending decomposition: each dashboard panel becomes its own component file under features/dashboard/.

apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/p.reason: Pending decomposition: split the calendar grid from the item editor.

apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/s.reason: Pending decomposition: split the MCP server list from the extension install flow.
Pending decomposition: export, import and templates panels become separate components.

apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/u.reason: Static content: the User Guide copy (sections, tasks, actions). Data, not logic; the checklist tasks already live apart in guide-tasks.ts.

packages/intelligence/src/knowledge/grap.reason: Experimental API (P2-4): split entity extraction from graph storage and query when it graduates to stable.

packages/intelligence/src/metrics/dashbo.reason: Experimental API (P2-4): split collection from aggregation and trend analysis when it graduates to stable.

packages/intelligence/src/observability/.reason: Experimental API (P2-4): split span storage from W3C propagation when it graduates to stable.

packages/intelligence/src/rag/chunker-v2.reason: Pending decomposition: separate Markdown structure parsing from chunk assembly. Behaviour is pinned by chunker.property.test.ts (P1-2).

packages/intelligence/src/service/unifie.reason: Pending decomposition: the unified service wires RAG, memory, knowledge graph, planning and tracing; each integration becomes its own adapter.

packages/shared-types/src/entities.ts.reason: Declarative: the shared entity type vocabulary, no logic. Split candidate by domain (people, work, extensions, local runtime) like ipc/ when it next grows.

packages/shared-types/src/events.ts.reason: Declarative: the closed EventType list plus one payload interface per event, kept together so the runtime list and the union cannot drift.
